'''Rodma Maddel''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Rebel trooper|soldier]] that served as a [[Corporal]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="UVG" />

Maddel was an [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|intelligence]] [[agent]] recruited by [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and served as an advanced [[scout]] for urban combat units.<ref name="UVG" /> She was walking across one of the landing pads in front of the [[Great Temple]] as rebel agents [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] and [[Jyn Erso]] boarded a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] to leave for the [[moon]] [[Jedha]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Maddel did not hesitate to join [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron's]] ground reinforcements during the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="UVG" />
